title: Gold Races Toward $5,000 as Silver Hits a Record $100
text: As the price of gold drew near a milestone on Friday, one metal outshone it: silver, which climbed past $100 per troy ounce for the first time in history.  Most-active silver futures settled at $101.33, rising 5.2% to mark a record high.  The price of gold settled up 1.4% at $4,979.70, just a touch below the $5,000 level, but marking the best weekly performance since March 2020.
